dataset: UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset
selection_metric: F1-score for the purchase class; ROC-AUC and accuracy break ties

metric_explanations.accuracy: Share of all test sessions whose purchase status was classified correctly.
metric_explanations.precision: Share of sessions predicted as purchases that were actual purchases.
metric_explanations.recall: Share of actual purchase sessions that the model correctly identified.
metric_explanations.f1: Harmonic mean of purchase precision and recall.
metric_explanations.roc_auc: Ability to rank purchase sessions above non-purchase sessions across thresholds.
